name: Event-market making: spread capture vs settlement carry, rebate wedge and taker-delay last look
one_line: Two-sided quoting across long-tail event markets where makers earn mostly by what they hold at settlement and where they quote, plus a deterministic rebate; spread capture is ~0 in liquid markets.
maturity: Established as a class (limit-order makers are the documented winners); unproven for a new solo entrant
requires_ai: optional: jump-risk and rule-change tagging, never quoting
edge: Screening rent from tail-demand takers, fee wedge, 15-25% rebate
capital: $10k+ to run; $1k-$10k to validate; carry locks capital to resolution
build_time: 4-6 weeks on an LP stack; 2-3 months from scratch
opportunity_size: ~800 bots cleared ~$131M in 16 months; maker rebates ~$187k/day; liquid spreads saturated, long tail stable
expected_results: no public data for a solo maker; guess -$50 to +$100/day net on $20-50k
competition: desks in liquid markets; ~32 effective makers per long-tail market
flag: none (one identity); grey multi-wallet; spoofing/wash prohibited
validate: Decompose own or paper fills into spread/rebate/rewards/settlement by price band; carry only positive bands
top_risk: Informed jumps and insider flow against held inventory
solo_fit_reason: Reuses LP infrastructure and the class is profitable, but the rent comes from a settlement-carry policy that needs months of measured fills; one-day evidence, institutional competition and fat left tails make it a slow build.
speed_class: execution-sensitive: selection and carry policy beat speed; news cancels decide losses
capacity_ceiling: ~$100k-250k solo before quoting liquid markets against desks
changes_made: Corrected the brief: the 91.4% settlement-profit figure is from a one-day BTC 5-minute sample (738,393 trades), not the full 588M-trade record.
Added live 24 Sep spread and fee-schedule data; NFL/CFB zero-fee (no rebate).
Crypto taker delay updated to 150 ms (2026-09-04).
open_doubts: No small-maker net PnL anywhere; settlement-carry evidence is one day of BTC 5-minute data plus the authors' platform-wide claim.
